Eagle Mfg 1633 1-Drum Modular Low-Profile Spill Containment Platform (15-Gallon Sump, 2,000 lb Capacity),eagle-mfg-1633-1-drum-modular-low-profile-spill-containment-platform-h0424182,"<div class=""hathoro-product-description"" style=""font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

The Eagle Mfg 1633 is a commercial-grade, modular secondary spill containment platform engineered specifically for the safe storage and dispensing of one 55-gallon industrial drum. Molded from high-density polyethylene (HDPE), this ultra-low-profile containment deck protects warehouse floors, personnel, and surrounding facilities against catastrophic leaks, continuous drips, and corrosive chemical spills.

column2: >15-Gallon Secondary Sump Capacity: Captures accidental overflow and minor container breaches directly beneath stored drums, ensuring immediate containment before hazardous substances reach drainage systems.
>Industrial 2,000 lb Load Rating: Engineered internal support ribs safely distribute dynamic weight loads, supporting fully filled 55-gallon steel, polyethylene, or composite drums without bowing.
>Ergonomic 6.5"" Low-Profile Clearance: Low deck height drastically minimizes physical strain during drum loading, forklift loading, manual positioning, and rotary pump dispensing.

>100% Chemical-Grade Polyethylene (HDPE): Seamless, rotationally molded construction will never rust, corrode, or degrade when exposed to aggressive industrial acids, caustics, fuels, or synthetic solvents.
>Modular Floor Expansion System: Includes patented heavy-duty U-channel connectors allowing multiple platforms to interlock effortlessly into a custom multi-drum containment zone.
>Removable Anti-Skid Poly Grate: High-traction textured black grating prevents container slipping and lifts out in seconds for swift sump pump-out and visual inspection.

column1: Unchecked industrial leaks can trigger costly facility shutdowns, hazardous environmental cleanup costs, and significant regulatory fines. The Eagle Mfg 1633 satisfies strict EPA 40 CFR 264.175 requirements for container storage and complies with Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure (SPCC) protocols to safeguard your facility during municipal and federal safety audits.

column3: >Safe containment for cutting fluids, machining oils, and hydraulic lubricants.
>Corrosion-proof secondary basin for acids, alkalines, and active reagents.
>Stationary containment for motor oil, transmission fluids, and glycol coolants.
>Safe staging and regulatory transit point for liquid chemical distribution.
